d:
While some roads take you places, others take you back in time. In Episode 2 of Terrible Roads to Terrific Places, Shapur Kotwal takes the Renault Duster deep into Nagaland, towards Longwa, a remote village on the India-Myanmar border. From visiting the Angh’s house, discovering generations-old craftsmanship and experiencing local Naga cuisine, Lungwa offers a glimpse into a world that feels far removed from the familiar.
Getting here is no easy feat, but that’s precisely the point.
Producer: Mohammed Shahreyar
Camerapersons: Sharad Vegada, Pravin Bhondave
Editor: Siddhesh Kadam
